page: Microsoft Azure NG16ads_V620_v1 is an accelerator-enabled virtual instance from the NGADSV620v1 family, built on Microsoft Hyper-V virtualization and powered by an x86_64 AMD processor architecture. The instance allocates 16 dedicated vCPUs alongside 32.0 GB of system memory, producing a 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 2.0 GB per core. Network deployments operate without complimentary public IPv4 addresses, relying on private networking or separately provisioned public routing.

Hardware acceleration is driven by a partitioned 0.5 AMD V620 GPU provisioning 16 GB of dedicated VRAM. Storage architecture incorporates an integrated 2470 GB local NVMe solid-state drive for low-latency scratch operations, paired with baseline capability for Azure Premium Storage remote disks. The bundled NVMe tier provides high local throughput directly on the physical host.

From an infrastructure efficiency perspective, the fractional GPU allocation permits workloads needing visual compute and hardware encoding to avoid the cost footprint of an entire discrete GPU adapter. The high-capacity local NVMe volume complements this by accommodating large working datasets locally without requiring auxiliary disk attachments. These specifications make the server suited for cloud graphics virtualization, interactive streaming, 3D rendering pipelines, and GPU-assisted media processing.
description: Microsoft Azure NG16ads_V620_v1 is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine within the NGADSV620v1 family, running on Microsoft Hyper-V with x86_64 AMD processors. The configuration supplies 16 dedicated vCPUs alongside 32.0 GB of system memory, establishing a 2.0 GB per core resource density. Acceleration is delivered via a fractional 0.5 AMD V620 GPU equipped with 16 GB of video memory, providing dedicated graphics compute without requiring a complete physical adapter. Local I/O demands are handled by an integrated 2470 GB NVMe SSD, complemented by capability for Azure Premium Storage. The instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 networking. By pairing a fractional GPU with substantial high-speed local solid-state storage, this server offers a resource-efficient footprint for visual computing, rendering, streaming, and GPU-assisted data processing applications.
